doc.name: cross-covenant-bible
doc.instructions: Public-domain Bible text (World English Bible and King James Version), Bible reading plans, and a daily devotional from Cross + Covenant. All tools are read-only.

tools.name: get_passage
tools.title: Get a Bible passage
tools.description: Returns the text of a Bible passage from the World English Bible or the King James Version, both public domain. Accepts a verse, a range, whole chapters, or several references joined with ";" (for example "John 3:16", "Psalm 23", "Romans 8:28-39", "1 Cor 13:4-7; Micah 6:8"). Up to 150 verses or 2 chapters per call; a longer request returns the first part and names the rest.

translation.description: Translation: "web" (World English Bible, the default) or "kjv" (King James Version).

tools.name: search_scripture
tools.title: Search scripture
tools.description: Finds Bible verses containing the given words in the World English Bible or the King James Version, ranked by how closely each verse matches. Common words are ignored, and a word also matches longer forms (fear matches fears and feared). Can be limited to one book or one testament.

query.description: Words to find, for example "do not be afraid" or "living water".

translation.description: Translation: "web" (World English Bible, the default) or "kjv" (King James Version).

book.description: Limit to one book, for example "Psalms" or "John".

limit.description: How many verses to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

tools.name: list_reading_plans
tools.title: List reading plans
tools.description: Lists the Cross + Covenant Bible reading plans: the M'Cheyne one-year plan, which follows the calendar, and five short topical plans (hope, peace, strength, the Psalms, the life of Jesus). Gives each plan's id, length and purpose.

tools.name: get_reading_plan_day
tools.title: Get a reading plan day
tools.description: Returns the passages for one day of a Cross + Covenant reading plan, by day number or, for the one-year M'Cheyne plan, by calendar date (today in Mountain Time when neither is given). With include_text, also returns the passage text (up to 150 verses) in the World English Bible or King James Version.

plan_id.description: Plan id: "mcheyne" (one year) or a topical plan id.

day.description: Day number in the plan, starting at 1.

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form. One-year plan only.

include_text.description: Also return the text of the day's passages. Default false.

translation.description: Translation: "web" (World English Bible, the default) or "kjv" (King James Version).

tools.name: get_devotional
tools.title: Get the devotional
tools.description: Returns the Cross + Covenant daily devotional for a date: a scripture passage in the World English Bible or King James Version, a short reflection, and a prayer. Defaults to today in Mountain Time. On a date without a devotional available here, returns that day's scripture instead.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Defaults to today in Mountain Time.
